elements.justification: sig.headlamp, 'headlamp state in {off, low_beam, high_beam}': lighted headlamps are a state other than off.

'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, one ru.aggregate atom. 'parked' is drv.motion.parked, 'Road user a is parked: "the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not", observed as a at rest at every observation of the window behind', as the index maps 'parked' (NRS_484B_473_2).
Depressed or dimmed headlamps are the low beam: sig.headlamp state low_beam, not high_beam; as the index maps 'such lights shall be depressed or dimmed' (NRS_484B_473_2).

applicability: The subject is a member of the vehicle aggregate, drv.motion.parked holds for it (speed tolerance p.halt_speed_tolerance, duration p.parking_min_duration), and its headlamps are lit (sig.headlamp low_beam or high_beam) at the observation.
obligation: The subject's headlamps are on low beam (sig.headlamp low_beam) at the observation.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car of the vehicle aggregate has stood at rest at the curb for five minutes with its headlamps on high beam.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the headlamps are on low beam.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A car has stood at rest at the curb for five minutes with its headlamps off.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car has stood at rest at the curb for five minutes; the source does not observe headlamps.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A car halts for twenty seconds in traffic with high beams on: a halt shorter than the parking duration is not parked.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: sensor speed resolution of the acquisition standard

param_proposals.name: p.parking_min_duration
param_proposals.convention: the longest halt counted as temporary, as for loading or unloading: a common time limit of a passenger loading zone
param_proposals.source: municipal passenger loading zone time limits
